bodies.name: Streets and Transportation Subcommittee, 2024 Bond Task Force

answer.rationale: Official June 13, 2023 minutes identify the convening body as the Streets and Transportation Subcommittee of the 2024 Bond Task Force and list its committee members separately from presenting Public Works and Transportation staff. The player and chapter identify recording 259821 as the corresponding June 13 bond meeting. Assign the dedicated subcommittee feed and the broader Bond Program Meetings subscription grouping under the configured bond-family policy. The grouping is not an additional convening institution. The parent task force is not proven to have jointly convened this meeting; the transcript instead references another task force presentation at 6:30. Transportation-related subject matter does not establish ownership by a separate Council transportation committee.
